market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $140 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100. To settle at $140 requires a 40% rally in ~2 months. That is a large geopolitical-shock move, e.g., a sustained Hormuz closure or major Gulf hostilities. Possible given the war footing but not the base case. Market's 0.205 looks slightly optimistic on tail risk.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Probability of a Hormuz closure or large supply outage in May-June
